identity_rule: Mực sống trên lụa cũ, đồng ám giữ khung, ngọc quang chỉ bùng lên khi kiếm ý vận hành.

materials: Warm xuan paper and aged silk grain form the quiet world and support planes.
Blue-black wet and dry ink defines silhouettes, brush edges and deep lacquer fields.
Aged bronze and sparse gold provide thin structure, milestones and ritual hardware without glossy plastic bevels or oversized ornament.
Jade light and cinnabar seals remain restrained functional accents rather than full-screen grading.
shape_language: Scalable Godot-native asymmetric ritual plaques with clipped, folded or bracketed corners.
Control silhouette and negative space carry hierarchy before decoration; raster chrome never rescues a weak layout.
Tall irregular talisman folios with protected runtime text fields and separate sigil medallions.
Compact readable actor silhouettes: light cultivator plane, low ink beasts, upright corrupted cultivators and a broad horned boss.
Broken brush rings, seals and ordered sword triangles communicate combat state without debug-vector geometry.
camera_and_view: Three-quarter top-down arena view with bottom-anchored actor sprites and visible ground contact.
1600x900 desktop reference composition, centered at wider aspects without stretching authored chrome.
Dedicated 844x390 phone device-space layouts; the desktop composition is never merely shrunk onto a phone.
lighting: Soft upper-left paper light with restrained ink pooling and minimal rim light.
No plastic specular highlights, neon bloom wash or conflicting per-asset light direction.
Player, reward and threat cues preserve value separation at 640x360 thumbnail scale.
palette_roles: Warm paper #E7DDC4/#C9B995 supports quiet surfaces and secondary type fields.
Deep ink #0B171B/#17292D/#314248 owns silhouettes, lacquer and primary dark structure.
Jade #55C9A6/#A9F1D5 indicates the player, safety, selection and controllable power.
Cinnabar #B43D35/#E06B52 indicates hostility, damage, destructive actions and boss pressure.
Aged bronze/gold #8A6730/#C69A48/#F0D184 indicates hardware, selection and realm milestones.
Violet corruption #675078/#9A78A9 is secondary hostile ink and never player power.
typography_roles: Runtime-rendered Vietnamese text only; generated textures contain no lettering or pseudo-calligraphy.
Compact uppercase eyebrows establish context, high-contrast ritual titles establish hierarchy and quiet body copy explains consequences.
Critical HUD values use protected high-contrast fields and remain readable above moving world art.
Body text is never reduced to compensate for overcrowding; composition and copy density are corrected first.
detail_density: World edges and ritual objects carry painterly detail while center gameplay lanes retain deliberate negative space.
Functional color occupies a small minority of a normal combat frame; detail cannot overwhelm silhouette or hierarchy.
Texture and ornament must survive actual runtime size and may not depend on source-scale hairlines.
motion_and_fx: Actor loops preserve feet pivots, body scale and silhouette across idle, movement and boss phases.
Jade sword and qi feedback grows through ordered additional shapes, trails and seals as technique rank rises.
Boss warnings show a complete broken-brush danger boundary plus an advancing timing ring and non-color rune language.
UI transitions are short ritual fades or reveals; reduced-motion mode retains all state information.

forbidden_drift: No glossy mobile bevels, glassmorphism, neon gradients or plastic 3D material response.
No generic rounded SaaS cards, equal-weight dashboard grids or default engine controls presented as final UI.
No stretched folios, arbitrary nine-sliced prop crops, repeated one-size-fits-all ornate frames or text colliding with ornament.
No full-screen wallpaper swap for every meta screen and no cover-cropping that removes the focal subject on phone layouts.
No raster-generated button or panel chrome as the default control layer; production controls use scalable native silhouettes.
No primitive-only final actors, pickups or impacts and no visible collision/debug geometry.
No inconsistent camera, light direction, texture density or actor grounding between generated asset families.
No baked text, pseudo-Chinese glyphs, logos, watermarks or generated inscriptions.

change_control.change_reason: Lock the user-approved V4 master UI board for complete desktop and mobile implementation
